book.name: 2 Amǝ Tasalonika
book.title: Ɓaria Cauterǝa mala Bulǝs aban ká a ban AMƏ TASALONIKA

content: Ɓwa mala Cauɓikea
Sǝm nggǝ earce lǝmdǝa wun gir amur cau mala nyare yiu mala Mǝtala sǝm Yesu Kǝrǝsti, andǝ dapi ma'sǝm a banɓwáná a baní.
Sǝm nggǝ zǝmba wun, wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu ama,

wu kǝa kaurǝa arǝ dǝurǝo ɗang. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ ɓabum wun ɓǝ̀ kǝa lo, nǝ cau mǝnana aɓea ɓwana na ama Pwari mala Mǝtalabangŋo angŋa dǝmba yina pale ka ɗàng. À nǝ̀ gandǝ bang ama à sǝni aɓa bangŋo, ko à oe a kún ɓeɓwa, ko à ɓalli aɓa ɓè cauterǝa mǝnana à twali ama pur nǝban sǝm ngga.

Wu kǝa eare ɓǝ̀ kǝɓwa swarki wun ɗàng ko bǝti. Acemǝnana mǝno yì pwari ka pà nǝ̀ yiu peatu ɗang she ɓǝ̀ masǝlǝata Mgbicau arǝ Ɓakuli yina, sǝ Ɓwa mala Cauɓikea pusǝna rǝì, mǝno yì ɓwa mǝnana dupî ká kìɗìkì ka.
Yì ka, nda ɓiu-mǝbura mǝnana kǝ loasǝ ɓamúrì amur Ɓakuli andǝ agir mǝnana kat aɓwana kǝ peri abania ka. Yàle nǝ̀ kutio a Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli nǝ̀ duk kam, nǝ̀ na ama yì nda Ɓakuli.
Ɓalǝ wun kasǝ mbo ama ǝn bangga wun cau amur amǝnia yi agir ka mǝnana mǝ nda atà wun ɗiɗyal ka?
Sǝ wu sùrǝ́nà rǝ gir mǝnana kǝ tamsǝi mǝnia yì Ɓwa mala Cauɓikea arǝ pusǝrǝi ado ka. À eari wi ɓǝ̀ pusǝrǝi ado ɗàng sheɓǝ̀ pwari mǝnana à tsǝki wi yi pangŋǝ̀nà ka.
Rǝcandǝa mala ɓealɓikea ka, angŋa dǝmba nǝ̀ nggǝ pak túró aɓa sǝmbǝrǝa, sǝ anggo ka, nǝ̀ ueo aɓa sǝmbǝrǝa she ɓǝà gǝshina ɓwa mǝnana akiyì njar male ka.
Sǝ à nǝ̀ yia lǝmdǝí, yì Ɓwa mala Cauɓikea, mǝnana Mǝtalabangŋo Yesu nǝ̀ wal-luí nǝ yálí kúni, sǝ nǝ̀ kiɗiki rǝcandǝa male nǝ̀ nyesǝi ɓà, nǝ́ tǎ mala ɓoarɓwa mala yiu male ka.
Yì Ɓwa mala Cauɓikea man ngga, nǝ̀ yiu nǝ rǝcandǝa mala Shetan, nǝ̀ yia pakki agir-ndǝlǝki, andǝ agir-lǝmdǝa, andǝ agir-gyambǝliban mǝ'nyirnì ɗàngɗáng.

Yì ka, nǝ̀ pak túró nǝ koya nggaman swarkiban mǝnana ɓealɓikea kǝ yiu nǝi ka, amur aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ ká nǝ ká kìɗìkì ka. Amǝnia yì aɓwana ka, à nǝ̀ kìɗìkì, acemǝnana à ginǝ ak mǝsǝcau sǝ à ginǝ earce mǝsǝcau a ɓabumia, mǝnana nda nǝ̀ yinǝia ɓǝà kum amsǝban ngga.
Ace mani ka, Ɓakuli nǝ̀ tasǝia wia swarkiban mǝcandǝe, à nǝ̀ earnǝ nyir.
Anggo ka aɓwana mǝnana kat à ginǝ earnǝ mǝsǝcau, à pak banɓoarnado aɓa ɓealɓikea ka, à nǝ̀ kasǝia wia ɓashi lú.
Wu tamsǝ kusǝ wun kàngkàngwun amǝkpata Yesu

Sǝ sǝm ngga, ndanǝ ɓoaro ɓǝ̀ sǝm nggǝ pakki Ɓakuli yàwá ace wun, wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu mǝnana Mǝtalabangŋo earkiyi acea raka. Ɓakuli ka tàrki wun kǝla aɓǝla agir mǝdǝmbe ace amsǝ wun, ɓǝ̀ wu duk aɓwana male, nǝ rǝcandǝa mala Bangŋo male, sǝ nǝ paɓamuru ma'wun arǝ mǝsǝcau ka.
Yì nǝ̀ tunǝ wun, nǝ Cau Amsǝban mǝnana sǝm hamnǝi a ban wun ngga, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu kum kāmbe aɓa gulo mala Mǝtala sǝm Yesu Kǝrǝsti.
Ace mani ka, wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu, wu tamsǝ kusǝ wun kàngkàng, wu bwal mǝsǝcau mǝnana sǝm kania wun kat aɓa bang cau, andǝ cauterǝa ka.
Sǝm nggǝ zǝmba ama Mǝtala sǝm Yesu Kǝrǝsti nǝ nggearǝì, andǝ Ɓakuli Tár sǝm mǝnana earce sǝm, sǝ aɓa ɓwamuru male ka, pana sǝm girikiban mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka, andǝ tsǝkɓalǝu mǝgule ka,
ɓǝ̀ ɓak ɓabum wun sǝ ɓǝ̀ pà wun rǝcandǝa mala pě andǝ ne mǝɓoarne.
